facts.fact: Any user may nominate an article to be collaborated upon for dinosaur-related topics.
Featured Articles are reserved for articles that have received 'Featured article' status after peer review and meet current criteria.
In Dinosaur Wiki, only Founders, Bureaucrats, and Sysops may edit the Featured Article Nominations page.
